sentence_stem: Because she has got a car,
correct_completion: she can drive to work every day.
full_sentence: Because she has got a car, she can drive to work every day.
acceptable_variants: she can drive her friends to school.
she can go to the park by car.

options.why_wrong: Having a car makes driving more likely, so 'walks' does not follow from the cause given in the stem.
Being tired does not follow from having a car, so this does not complete the cause-and-effect logic.

options.text: she can drive to work every day.

options.why_wrong: This repeats the 'has got' structure, but a bicycle does not explain why she can drive.

grammar_focus: Cause and effect with 'because' and 'has got'
explanation: After 'because', the stem gives the reason. The completion must be the result that logically follows from owning a car.
translation: Arabası olduğu için her gün işe arabayla gidebiliyor.
